chunk:
deviations:
  - "No HL7 FHIR R4 resource maps directly to an HCBS Regional Center service authorization. FHIR Coverage is the closest analog but lacks regional-center-specific constructs (service hours per month, regional center assignment, HCBS service codes). This canonical is derived from California DDS authorization data structures and DCI/Salesforce EVV implementations."
  - "CMS/FHIR CareTeam and CarePlan resources partially overlap but are not appropriate as a canonical hub for EVV authorization-hours tracking."

description: >
  Canonical record for a Home and Community-Based Services (HCBS) service authorization issued by a
  regional center to a consumer. Represents the monthly approved service hours a consumer is entitled to
  receive for a specific service code under their regional center contract.
  Used by Cherish Care (California DDS respite services — IRC, SGP, ELR).

required:
  - authorizationId
  - consumerId
  - serviceCode
  - authorizedHoursPerMonth
  - effectiveDate
  - regionalCenter

properties:
  authorizationId:
    type: string
    description: Unique authorization identifier — regional center reference number or DCI auth ID
  consumerId:
    type: string
    description: Consumer/client identifier this authorization is issued for
  serviceCode:
    type: string
    description: HCBS service/procedure code this authorization covers (e.g., H2015, H0045)
  serviceDescription:
    type: string
    description: Human-readable service description (e.g., "Respite Care — In Home", "IHSS")
  authorizedHoursPerMonth:
    type: number
    description: Monthly hour budget approved by the regional center
  authorizedHoursPerYear:
    type: number
    description: Annual hour budget (if applicable — some authorizations are annual)
  effectiveDate:
    type: string
    format: date
    description: First date this authorization is valid (YYYY-MM-DD)
  expirationDate:
    type: string
    format: date
    description: Last date this authorization is valid — authorizations typically run 1 year
  regionalCenter:
    type: string
    enum: [IRC, SGP, ELR]
    description: Issuing regional center (Inland RC, San Gabriel RC, Eastern LA RC)
  vendorId:
    type: string
    description: Regional center vendor/provider ID for Cherish Care under this authorization
  status:
    type: string
    enum: [active, expired, cancelled, pending_renewal]
    description: Current status of the authorization
  hoursUsedThisMonth:
    type: number
    description: Computed — hours alread
